raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MORI EPv2 currently runs only its native dispatch/combine, which finishes the whole transfer inside one call, so nothing can run while tokens move. MORI's AsyncLL kernels (ROCm/mori#768) split each transfer into a send and a receive half, and with `MORI_ENABLE_SDMA=1` move the tokens on the copy engine instead of CUs.

This PR drives those kernels from SGLang and uses them for single-batch overlap (`--enable-single-batch-overlap`). On AMD, SBO runs the shared experts in the dispatcher's dispatch hook, between `dispatch_a` and `dispatch_b`. With the send in `dispatch_a` and the receive in `dispatch_b`, the shared experts now overlap the transfer.

It is independent of two-batch overlap. #44492 carries the same AsyncLL dispatcher together with DSV4 prefill TBO + DSpark; whichever PR merges first, the other is rebased onto it.

## Modifications

| Commit | Change |
|---|---|
| `[AMD] MORI EPv2: run dispatch/combine on MORI's AsyncLL kernels` | `moriep.py`: EPv2 is split like EPv1 into a base plus `_MoriEPv2DispatcherImplNormal` (native kernels, unchanged) and `_MoriEPv2DispatcherImplAsyncLL(overlap)`. `--deepep-mode low_latency` or `MORI_ENABLE_SDMA=1` selects AsyncLL (`sdma` transport with SDMA, `lsa` peer stores otherwise). AsyncLL uses the hip backend, MORI's own launch geometry, no comm stream, and a cco window sized from MORI's `asyncll_regions`. It has no fp4 dispatch or quantized combine: FP4-weight MoE dispatches MXFP8 when aiter can produce it, else bf16 (gfx1250 stays bf16: its a8w4 MoE takes no pre-quantized activation); combine is bf16. `SGLANG_MORI_RECV_BOUND` covers the AsyncLL receive layout. `moe_hook.py`: low_latency no longer rewrites to normal on EPv2 and SDMA no longer forces EPv1; a MORI build without EPv2 AsyncLL falls back to EPv1. Docs, CPU unit tests, and `MODE=low_latency` / `MORI_ENABLE_SDMA=1` in the manual dispatcher test. |
| `[Fix] MORI EPv2: let every rank finish the LSA probe before tearing it down` | With `MORI_ENABLE_SDMA` the temporary device comm in `_cco_lsa_size` trades SDMA queue IPC handles; a rank closing it early left a peer blocked forever. Barrier before closing (gfx1250 EP4 sdma: 2/12 hangs before, 0/20 after). |
| `[AMD] MORI EPv2 AsyncLL: let SBO run shared experts between send and receive` | `low_latency` already receives in `dispatch_b`. `normal` + `MORI_ENABLE_SDMA=1` received right after sending; under SBO without TBO it now leaves the receive to `dispatch_b` too. Unit test pins the order. |

On AMD only `SboFlags.enable_dispatch_shared_one_stream_overlap` applies (the combine / down-GEMM overlaps need DeepGEMM or CuTe DSL). Native EPv2 finishes its transfer in one call, so single-stream SBO has nothing to overlap there; that path is unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

DeepSeek-V4-Flash, gfx1250, EP4 single node, DSpark, DP attention, CUDA-graph decode, `SGLANG_MORI_RECV_BOUND=1`, `--chunked-prefill-size 32768`, no TBO. gsm8k, 200 questions:

| Transport | This branch, SBO off | This branch, SBO on | On #44492 (same AsyncLL code), SBO off ×2 / on ×2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `low_latency` + SDMA | 0.960 | 0.960 | 0.960, 0.965 / 0.945, 0.945 |
| `normal` + SDMA | 0.960 | 0.955 | 0.955, 0.960 / 0.945, 0.945 |
| native EPv2 (no AsyncLL) | 0.955 | – | – |

All within the run-to-run noise of 200 questions.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

Same setup. Decode load: 256 requests, ISL 1024 / OSL 512, concurrency 64. Prefill load: 384 requests, ISL 8192 / OSL 16, concurrency 128.

This branch:

| Transport | SBO | decode output tok/s | decode mean ITL (ms) | decode mean TTFT (ms) | prefill input tok/s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `low_latency` + SDMA | off | 1755 | 29.79 | 1227 | 19696 |
| `low_latency` + SDMA | on | 1816 (+3.5%) | 28.97 | 1223 | 20583 (+4.5%) |
| `normal` + SDMA | off | 1760 | 29.73 | 1197 | 20294 |
| `normal` + SDMA | on | 1806 (+2.6%) | 28.86 | 1207 | 20475 (+0.9%) |
| native EPv2 (no AsyncLL, unchanged path) | – | 1793 | 29.18 | 1190 | 20369 |

SBO gain, repeated on the same nodes with the same AsyncLL code on top of #44492, alternating off / on / off / on:

| Transport | SBO off (2 runs) | SBO on (2 runs) | decode gain | ITL | prefill gain |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `low_latency` + SDMA | 1753 / 1769 | 1816 / 1834 | +3.7% | 29.61 → 28.79 ms | +3.1% |
| `normal` + SDMA | 1744 / 1772 | 1809 / 1833 | +3.6% | 29.63 → 28.88 ms | +3.1% |

Every SBO-on run beats every SBO-off run; repeated runs of one config differ by 1–1.6%.

At this size (EP4 on one node) the native EPv2 kernels are about as fast as AsyncLL + SBO (1793 vs 1806–1816 tok/s), and AsyncLL without SBO is ~2% behind native. Larger EP (EP8 / EP16 across a UALink vPOD), where transfers are longer, is not measured yet.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-and-profiling).

When unset, EPv2 is used for DeepSeek-V4 on AITER with a bfloat16 model dtype and ep_size <= 8 (on gfx1250, any ep_size within one UALink vPOD), and EPv1 otherwise; AsyncLL modes also need a MORI build with EPv2 AsyncLL. true forces EPv2 (warning on any failed check), false forces EPv1. +"""CPU-only tests for how the MORI EPv2 dispatcher drives its transport.
+
+The MORI op is a fake that logs its calls, so these pin which calls each mode
+makes and when, not what the kernels compute.
+"""

+    """Just enough of MORI for the EPv2 impls' import probe."""
+    mori = ModuleType("mori")
+    cco = ModuleType("mori.cco")
+    cco.Communicator = object
+    ops = ModuleType("mori.ops")
+    v2 = ModuleType("mori.ops.dispatch_combine_v2")
+    v2.EpDispatchCombineOp = object
+    return {
+        "mori": mori,
+        "mori.cco": cco,
+        "mori.ops": ops,
+        "mori.ops.dispatch_combine_v2": v2,
+    }

+class _FakeOp:
+    def __init__(self, log):
+        self.log = log
+        self.cfg = SimpleNamespace(
+            effective_max_recv=64, is_internode=False, is_scatter=False
+        )
+        self.backend_name = "hip"
+        self.dispatched = None
+        self.combined = None
+
+    def _dispatch_result(self, hidden, weights, indices):
+        self.dispatched = (
+            hidden.clone(),
+            weights.clone(),
+            None,
+            indices.clone(),
+            torch.tensor([hidden.shape[0]]),
+            "routing",
+        )
+        return self.dispatched
+
+    def dispatch(self, hidden, weights, scales, indices, **kwargs):
+        self.log.append("dispatch")
+        return self._dispatch_result(hidden, weights, indices)
+
+    def dispatch_send(self, hidden, weights, scales, indices, return_routing):
+        self.log.append("dispatch_send")
+        return self._dispatch_result(hidden, weights, indices)
+
+    def dispatch_recv(self):
+        self.log.append("dispatch_recv")
+
+    def combine(self, hidden, weights, indices, routing):
+        self.log.append("combine")
+        self.combined = hidden.clone()
+        return self.combined, None
+
+    def combine_send(self, hidden, weights, indices, routing):
+        self.log.append("combine_send")
+        self.combined = hidden.clone()
+        return self.combined, None
+
+    def combine_recv(self):
+        self.log.append("combine_recv")
+

+class _MoriEPv2TestCase(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        reset_context()
+        self.log = []
+        self._patches = [
+            patch.dict(sys.modules, _fake_mori_modules()),
+            patch.dict(os.environ),
+            patch.object(moriep, "get_is_extend_in_batch", return_value=False),
+            patch.object(
+                moriep, "_should_record_expert_distribution", return_value=False
+            ),
+            patch.object(torch.cuda, "is_current_stream_capturing", return_value=False),
+        ]
+        for item in self._patches:
+            item.start()
+        os.environ.pop("MORI_ENABLE_SDMA", None)
+        envs.SGLANG_MORI_EP_V2.set(True)
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        for item in reversed(self._patches):
+            item.stop()
+        reset_context()
+
+    def _make_dispatcher(self, deepep_mode, async_finish=False):
+        dispatcher = MoriEPDispatcher(
+            group=None,
+            router_topk=_TOPK,
+            hidden_size=_HIDDEN,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,

+        return dispatcher

+    @staticmethod

+        ids = torch.randint(0, 4, (num_tokens, _TOPK), dtype=torch.int32)
+        weights = torch.rand(num_tokens, _TOPK)
+        return hidden, StandardTopKOutput(weights, ids, None)

+class TestMoriEPv2Transport(_MoriEPv2TestCase):
+    def test_low_latency_sends_in_a_and_receives_in_b(self):
+        """TBO overlaps the sibling batch with the transfer only if the send half
+        runs in *_a and the receive half in *_b; both halves in *_b still give the
+        right result but lose the overlap."""
+        dispatcher = self._make_dispatcher(DeepEPMode.LOW_LATENCY)
+        op = dispatcher._get_impl().mori_op
+        hidden, topk_output = self._inputs()
+
+        dispatcher.dispatch_a(hidden, topk_output)
+        self.log.append("sibling")
+        dispatched = dispatcher.dispatch_b()
+        self.assertEqual(self.log, ["dispatch_send", "sibling", "dispatch_recv"])
+        # dispatch_b hands out the send half's buffers, which the receive fills.
+        self.assertIs(dispatched.hidden_states, op.dispatched[0])
+        self.assertIs(dispatched.topk_ids, op.dispatched[3])
+
+        del self.log[:]
+        dispatcher.combine_a(
+            (dispatched.hidden_states, dispatched.topk_ids, dispatched.topk_weights)
+        )
+        self.log.append("sibling")
+        combined = dispatcher.combine_b()
+        self.assertEqual(self.log, ["combine_send", "sibling", "combine_recv"])
+        self.assertIs(combined, op.combined)
+
+    def test_normal_sdma_receives_right_after_sending(self):
+        """EPv2 reaches SDMA only through the AsyncLL kernels, so normal + SDMA must
+        use them (the native calls do not exist on an AsyncLL op) and, with
+        nothing to overlap, receive as soon as it sends."""
+        os.environ["MORI_ENABLE_SDMA"] = "1"
+        dispatcher = self._make_dispatcher(DeepEPMode.NORMAL)
+        hidden, topk_output = self._inputs()
+
+        dispatcher.dispatch_a(hidden, topk_output)
+        self.log.append("sibling")
+        dispatched = dispatcher.dispatch_b()
+        dispatcher.combine_a(
+            (dispatched.hidden_states, dispatched.topk_ids, dispatched.topk_weights)
+        )
+        self.log.append("sibling")
+        dispatcher.combine_b()
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self.log,
+            [
+                "dispatch_send",
+                "dispatch_recv",
+                "sibling",
+                "combine_send",
+                "combine_recv",
+                "sibling",
+            ],
+        )
+
+    def test_async_ll_replaces_fp4_dispatch(self):
+        """AsyncLL has no fp4 dispatch: FP4-weight MoE falls back to MXFP8 when
+        aiter can quantize it, else to bf16; other weights fall back to bf16, and
+        so does gfx1250, whose a8w4 MoE takes no pre-quantized activation."""
+        fp4, bf16 = torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2, torch.bfloat16
+        for weight_dtype, mxfp8_ok, gfx1250, expected in (
+            (fp4, True, False, moriep.DispatchDtype.mxfp8),
+            (fp4, False, False, moriep.DispatchDtype.bf16),
+            (bf16, True, False, moriep.DispatchDtype.bf16),
+            (fp4, True, True, moriep.DispatchDtype.bf16),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(
+                weight_dtype=weight_dtype, mxfp8_ok=mxfp8_ok, gfx1250=gfx1250
+            ):
+                impl = self._make_dispatcher(DeepEPMode.LOW_LATENCY)._get_impl()
+                impl.quant_config = {"weight_dtype": weight_dtype}
+                impl.dispatch_dtype = moriep.DispatchDtype.fp4
+                with (
+                    patch.object(
+                        moriep, "_aiter_supports_mxfp8_dispatch", return_value=mxfp8_ok
+                    ),
+                    patch.object(moriep, "is_gfx1250_supported", return_value=gfx1250),
+                ):
+                    impl._restrict_transport_dtypes()
+                self.assertEqual(impl.dispatch_dtype, expected)
+
+    def test_normal_sdma_under_sbo_receives_in_b(self):
+        """SBO runs the shared experts in the dispatch hook, between dispatch_a and
+        dispatch_b, so normal + SDMA must leave the receive to dispatch_b for them
+        to overlap the transfer. TBO keeps its micro-batches back to back."""
+        os.environ["MORI_ENABLE_SDMA"] = "1"
+        for tbo, expected in (
+            (False, ["dispatch_send", "shared", "dispatch_recv"]),
+            (True, ["dispatch_send", "dispatch_recv", "shared"]),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(tbo=tbo):
+                del self.log[:]
+                with get_flags().moe.override(sbo_enabled=True, tbo_enabled=tbo):
+                    dispatcher = self._make_dispatcher(DeepEPMode.NORMAL)
+                hidden, topk_output = self._inputs()
+
+                dispatcher.dispatch_a(hidden, topk_output)
+                self.log.append("shared")
+                dispatcher.dispatch_b()
+                self.assertEqual(self.log, expected)
+

+    unittest.main()

+    """MORI EPv2 runs low_latency and SDMA on its AsyncLL kernels, so neither
+    is downgraded; a MORI build without them must still fall back to EPv1."""
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        self._env = patch.dict(os.environ)
+        self._env.start()
+        envs.SGLANG_USE_AITER.set(True)
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self._env.stop()
+
+    def _resolve(self, deepep_mode, async_ll, sdma=False):
+        import torch
+
+        # A fallback writes SGLANG_MORI_EP_V2=false, and an explicit value skips
+        # the checks, so start every resolution unset.
+        os.environ.pop("SGLANG_MORI_EP_V2", None)
+        os.environ["MORI_ENABLE_SDMA"] = "1" if sdma else "0"
+        server_args = ServerArgs(
+            model_path="dummy",
+            moe_a2a_backend="mori",
+            deepep_mode=deepep_mode,
+            tp_size=8,
+            chunked_prefill_size=1024,
+        )
+        server_args._model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+            nvfp4_moe_meta=None,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            hf_config=SimpleNamespace(architectures=["DeepseekV4ForCausalLM"]),
+        )
+        with (
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.arg_groups.moe_hook._mori_has_epv2_async_ll",
+                return_value=async_ll,
+            ),
+            patch("sglang.srt.configs.model_config.is_deepseek_v4", return_value=True),
+        ):
+            handle_a2a_moe(server_args)
+        return envs.SGLANG_MORI_EP_V2.get(), resolution_result(
+            server_args, "deepep_mode"
+        )
+
+    def test_resolution(self):
+        for deepep_mode, async_ll, sdma, expected in (
+            ("low_latency", True, False, (True, "low_latency")),
+            ("low_latency", False, False, (False, "low_latency")),
+            ("normal", False, True, (False, "normal")),
+            # The capability probe gates only the AsyncLL entries.
+            ("normal", False, False, (True, "normal")),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(deepep_mode=deepep_mode, async_ll=async_ll, sdma=sdma):
+                self.assertEqual(self._resolve(deepep_mode, async_ll, sdma), expected)
